suggested_requirements.text: The system shall provide instant messaging for real-time communication between users.
The system shall provide streaming audio and video capabilities for live and on-demand lectures.
The system shall allow users to create and customize personal profiles with pictures and contact information.
The system shall provide file hosting and management tools for users to upload, store, and retrieve files.
The system shall provide online testing tools with support for multiple question formats and instant grading.
The system shall allow users to customize the GUI background colors, fonts, and layout.
The system shall provide application sharing and whiteboard tools for collaborative work.
The system shall allow professors to host lectures as video or audio podcasts.
User passwords must be between 8 and 12 characters including letters and numbers but excluding spaces.
Users must change their passwords every three months.
The system shall support at least 250 concurrent users.
The system shall maintain an estimated 99% uptime.
The system shall provide printable manuals and online tutorials for users.
The system shall be compatible with Windows XP, Vista, or Mac OS.
The system shall be compatible with Internet Explorer, Mozilla Firefox, and Safari browsers.
Users must have pop-up windows enabled.
Users must have JavaScript enabled to use messaging and whiteboard software.
Users must have antivirus software installed to scan incoming files.
